Study across institutions and disciplines
From international collaborations to interdisciplinary degrees, UM offers flexible options to match your goals and interests.
Collaborative PhD Program
Study at UM and a university abroad as part of a collaborative PhD. You’ll work with supervisors from both institutions.
Learn more about the Collaborative PhD program
Joint Masters Programs (JMP)
Pursue a joint master’s degree from UM and the University of Winnipeg, with access to shared resources and faculty.

Take courses elsewhere
UM students can earn transfer credit from other recognized institutions.
Learn more about taking courses elsewhere
Postdoctoral Fellows
Postdoctoral fellowships are time-limited appointments designed to deepen expertise through advanced research and collaboration with faculty. Fellows are part of a supportive academic community with access to professional development through the Faculty of Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies.
Learn more about postdoctoral fellowships
